summary: The OVOS skill fleet's own gold intent corpus: the test split of OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents at tag v6.1, 2,380 utterances over 21 locales labelled with the canonical skill ids a real device registers. One row is an utterance and the intent it should fire.
notes: Test split of OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents at tag v6.1: 2,380 gold rows over 21 locales. No bucket is declared, so the ranked metric follows the default bucket handling. Labels are '<skill_id>:<intent_name>' with v6.1 intent names, and the template training split is pinned to the same commit. The m2v-v5-* heads were trained on the earlier v5 label set (OpenVoiceOS/ovos-intents d846a9a0, which has no test split): the English head can emit labels for 503 of 1,007 en-US rows, and every renamed label scores as a miss. The shipped default model OpenVoiceOS/ovos-m2v-intents-multilingual emits labels for 2,275 of 2,380 rows.
